description:
A hybrid electric bike, perfect for commuting and cruising.
The E-Lux Malibu blends contemporary lines and a battery forward design with the ultra-comfortable upright riding position that Elux is famous for… bringing you “Miles of Smiles” as you blast down the path!
Our 48 Volt 500 Watt (960 Peak Watt) Dapu motor and Samsung/Panasonic Battery drive train gives you tons of power for the hills and windy days while the tires and Zoom front suspension shock provide extra comfort as they suck up the bumps!
The Malibu comes standard with a 14ah Samsung/Panasonic powered battery providing a range of 35-45 miles with an optional 21ah long range battery boasting 60-70 miles! And being equipped with the 3 Level Power Adjust feature; you can control how hard the bike accelerates – adding extra power when you want or increasing range an additional 25-30% by dropping into “Eco” mode.
With a top speed of 22-24 mph performance braking is a must and the Tektro Auriga E-Comp Hydraulic Brakes with an oversized 203mm Front Disc deliver tons of stopping power while the integrated headlight, taillight, and active rear brake light increase safety daytime and night!
Get on a Malibu today and experience what Elux is all about… E-Luxury!

If your color is not available please call to check backorder availability.
